Min-heap of size k; root is the k-th largest. O(n log k).

For kth largest heap I will push then evict when size > k.

```python
import heapq
def kth_largest(nums, k):
    pq = []
    for x in nums:
        heapq.heappush(pq, x)
        if len(pq) > k: heapq.heappop(pq)
    return pq[0]
```
